title: 260425_113053_FR_Steam_locomotive_moving_at_Noyelles by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Steam locomotive moving at Noyelles station. I made this recording during ‘’La fête de la vapeur’’ (The Steam Festival), held in La Baie de Somme (north of France), at the end of April 2026. Here, one can hear a steam locomotives exhibited and used during the festival, moving and whistling through Noyelles train station, as well as a station agent asking people to go far from the railway. Recorded in April 2026 with a Zoom H5studio and its Zoom XYh-5s stock microphone. Fade in/out applied in Audacity.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -2.70 dBFS); 30 ms fades
